content2.content: Micro-interactions are subtle animations that provide feedback to the user, like a button press effect or a success checkmark.

content4.content: A common pattern is to shrink a button slightly when pressed.

content5.content:
GestureDetector(
  onTapDown: (_) => _controller.reverse(),
  onTapUp: (_) => _controller.forward(),
  child: ScaleTransition(
    scale: _controller,
    child: Container(...),
  ),
)

content7.content: These small details make the app feel responsive and polished.
